title: Daryl Hannah — Other work
text:
Title: Daryl Hannah — Other work

Hannah wrote, directed and produced a short film titled The Last Supper. She directed, produced, and was cinematographer for the documentary Strip Notes, which was broadcast on Channel 4 in the UK and on HBO and documented the research Hannah did for her role as a stripper in Dancing at the Blue Iguana. In 2002, Hannah appeared in Robbie Williams' video for the song "Feel" portraying Williams' love interest. Hannah and actress Hilary Shepard Turner created two board games, Love It or Hate It and LIEbrary. Hannah previewed the latter on The Ellen DeGeneres Show in 2005.
